lines:
  - id: eic.step5_line1
    printed: "(Step 5, 1)"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 1z"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line1z}
    refuses: [scope.religious_work]
    note: "Step 5 question 1 (Schedule SE filed as clergy or for church employee income) and the Clergy and Church employees adjustments to this line are not computed. The tool refuses any return with pay for religious work. This is broader than the IRS condition, but no narrower interface is supplied."

  - id: eic.step5_line2
    printed: "(Step 5, 2)"
    label: "Enter the Medicaid waiver payment amounts excluded from income on Schedule 1, line 8s, unless you choose to include these amounts in earned income, in which case enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    refuses: [scope.medicaid_waiver]
    note: "No input gives the excluded Medicaid waiver amount or the filer's choice to include it. The tool computes only returns with no Medicaid waiver payments, where the line is -0-. Other returns are refused through scope.medicaid_waiver."

  - id: eic.step5_line3
    printed: "(Step 5, 3)"
    label: "Subtract line 2 from line 1"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: eic.step5_line1, take: eic.step5_line2}

  - id: eic.step5_line4
    printed: "(Step 5, 4)"
    label: "Enter all of your nontaxable combat pay if you elect to include it in earned income"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    refuses: [s8812.combat_pay]
    note: "No input gives the elected nontaxable combat pay. The tool computes only returns with no nontaxable combat pay, where the line is zero. Returns with combat pay are refused through s8812.combat_pay."

  - id: eic.earned_income
    printed: "(Step 5, 5)"
    label: "Add lines 3 and 4. This is your earned income"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.step5_line3, eic.step5_line4]}

  - id: eic.wsb_4b
    printed: "4b"
    label: "Combine lines 1e, 2c, 3, and 4a. This is your total earned income"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.h_se_total, eic.earned_income]}
    shown_when: eic.h_use_wsb
    refuses: [scope.w2_marks, scope.farm, scope.k1]
    note: "Lines 1e and 2c (self-employment amounts, summed over all persons on the return) are read from the catalog field person.eic_se. It is taken to be each person's Worksheet B Part 1 or Part 2 amount. Line 4a is the Step 5 earned income. Part 3 (statutory employee) is not computed and is refused through scope.w2_marks. Farm and Schedule K-1 amounts are refused."

  - id: eic.wsb_6
    printed: "6 (eic.wsb_6)"
    label: "Enter your total earned income from Part 4, line 4b"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: eic.wsb_4b, take: {const: 0}}
    shown_when: eic.h_use_wsb
    note: "If line 4b is zero or less the worksheet stops. The credit is then zero through eic.eligible, so this line is floored at zero."

  - id: eic.line1
    printed: "1"
    label: "Enter your earned income from Step 5"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: eic.earned_income}
    shown_when: eic.h_use_wsa

  - id: eic.line2
    printed: "2"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 1 above in the EIC Table to find the credit. Enter the credit here"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_l1_inrange, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_l1_raw
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_l1_inrange, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
    shown_when: eic.h_use_wsa
    note: "An amount below the table's first row, or at or above the limit for the number of children, gives zero, as the table footnotes state."

  - id: eic.line3
    printed: "3"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line11b}
    shown_when: eic.h_use_wsa

  - id: eic.line4
    printed: "4"
    label: "Are the amounts on lines 3 and 1 the same?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.line3, eic.line1]}
    shown_when: eic.h_use_wsa

  - id: eic.line5
    printed: "5"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table to find the credit. Enter the credit here"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_l3_inrange, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_l3_raw
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_l3_inrange, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
    shown_when: eic.h_show5

  - id: eic.line6
    printed: "6 (eic.line6)"
    label: "This is your earned income credit"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard:
            op: test
            any:
              - {op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: true}]}
              - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_below, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.line2
        - guard:
            op: test
            not:
              op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_below, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_line6_min
    shown_when: eic.h_use_wsa

  - id: eic.eligible
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Eligible to take the EIC (Steps 1 to 5 passed and the worksheet's first table amount is not zero)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s1_agi, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.all_eic_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_inv_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s34_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s5_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ws_zero, {const: false}]}
    refuses: [sa.excluded_income, scope.nonresident, scope.rental, scope.f8814, scope.passive, household.eic_disallowed_claim]
    note: "Several points are open and are read as follows. (1) Eligibility means passing every STOP in Steps 1 to 5 and on worksheet lines A2 and B7. (2) Step 1 question 3 (Form 2555) is refused through sa.excluded_income. (3) Step 1 question 4 (nonresident alien) is refused. (4) Step 2 question 4 (Schedule E, rental of personal property, Form 8814, passive activity) is refused. (5) When investment income is over the limit, the filer is treated as not filing Form 4797, which is a STOP. (6) The Form 8862 situation is refused."

  - id: eic.credit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Earned income credit (Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 27a)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_amount
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero

  - id: eic.check_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box on line 27c"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s1_27c, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s12_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s34_27c, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s12_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s34_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s5_27c, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s12_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s34_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s5_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ws_zero, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [sa.excluded_income, scope.nonresident]
    note: "The box is true where the flow, followed in order, stops at an instruction to check line 27c: Step 1 question 2, Step 3 question 6, Step 4 questions 3 and 5, Worksheet B line 4b and question 5, and worksheet lines A2 or B7 being zero. No input asks whether the filer does not want to claim the credit, so that ground is not encoded."

    printed: "(helper)"

    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_kids, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, then: eic.h_thr0}
        - {guard: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_kids, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, then: eic.h_thr1}

  - id: eic.h_start
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "First amount in the EIC Table ($1)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.table_start}

  - id: eic.h_sc_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of Schedules C on the return"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.sc_count}

  - id: eic.h_use_wsb
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5, question 2: self-employed at any time in 2025 (use Worksheet B)"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_sc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
    note: "Self-employment is read as having a Schedule C. Other self-employment (partnership, farm, clergy, church employee, statutory employee) is refused elsewhere."

  - id: eic.h_use_wsa
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Use Worksheet A (answered No to Step 5, question 2)"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_use_wsb, {const: false}]}

  - id: eic.h_se_total
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B lines 1e and 2c, you and your spouse combined"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum_over, collection: person, field: person.eic_se}

  # lookups on line 1
  - {id: eic.h_l1_t0, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, line 1, no children", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}}
  - {id: eic.h_l1_t1, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, line 1, one child", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}}
  - {id: eic.h_l1_t2, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, line 1, two children", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}}
  - {id: eic.h_l1_t3, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, line 1, three or more children", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}}
  - id: eic.h_l1_raw
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 1 in the column for your number of children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_kids, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, then: eic.h_l1_t0}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_kids, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, then: eic.h_l1_t1}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_kids, {const: 2, type: Count}]}, then: eic.h_l1_t2}
        - {guard: {op: test, ge: [eic.h_kids, {const: 3, type: Count}]}, then: eic.h_l1_t3}
  - id: eic.h_l1_inrange
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 1 is within the EIC Table rows that give a credit"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line1, eic.h_start]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}

  # lookups on line 3
  - {id: eic.h_l3_t0, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, line 3, no children", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}}
  - {id: eic.h_l3_t1, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, line 3, one child", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}}
  - {id: eic.h_l3_t2, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, line 3, two children", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}}
  - {id: eic.h_l3_t3, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, line 3, three or more children", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}}
  - id: eic.h_l3_raw
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for line 3 in the column for your number of children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_kids, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, then: eic.h_l3_t0}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_kids, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, then: eic.h_l3_t1}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_kids, {const: 2, type: Count}]}, then: eic.h_l3_t2}
        - {guard: {op: test, ge: [eic.h_kids, {const: 3, type: Count}]}, then: eic.h_l3_t3}
  - id: eic.h_l3_inrange
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 3 is within the EIC Table rows that give a credit"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, eic.h_start]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_below
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 3 (Form 1040 line 11b) is less than the line 5 threshold"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, lt: [eic.line3, eic.h_thr]}

  - id: eic.h_show5
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A line 5 is completed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_use_wsa, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_below, {const: false}]}

  - id: eic.h_line6_min
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Smaller of lines 5 and 2"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.line2, eic.line5]}

  # Worksheet B lines 7-11
  - {id: eic.h_w6_t0, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, Worksheet B line 6, no children", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}}
  - {id: eic.h_w6_t1, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, Worksheet B line 6, one child", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}}
  - {id: eic.h_w6_t2, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, Worksheet B line 6, two children", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}}
  - {id: eic.h_w6_t3, printed: "(helper)", label: "EIC Table, Worksheet B line 6, three or more children", type: NonNegDollars, expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.wsb_6, status: f1040.status}}
  - id: eic.h_w6_raw
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit for Worksheet B line 6 in the column for your number of children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_kids, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, then: eic.h_w6_t0}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_kids, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, then: eic.h_w6_t1}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_kids, {const: 2, type: Count}]}, then: eic.h_w6_t2}
        - {guard: {op: test, ge: [eic.h_kids, {const: 3, type: Count}]}, then: eic.h_w6_t3}
  - id: eic.h_w6_inrange
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 6 is within the EIC Table rows that give a credit"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, ge: [eic.wsb_6, eic.h_start]}
        - {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_6, eic.h_limit]}
  - id: eic.h_wsb7
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 7: look up the amount on line 6 in the EIC Table to find the credit"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_w6_inrange, {const: true}]}, then: eic.h_w6_raw}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_w6_inrange, {const: false}]}, then: eic.h_zero}
  - id: eic.h_wsb9
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 9: are the amounts on lines 8 (Form 1040 line 11b) and 6 the same?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.line3, eic.wsb_6]}
    note: "Worksheet B line 8 is Form 1040 line 11b, the same amount as Worksheet A line 3. Worksheet B line 10 is the same lookup as Worksheet A line 5."
  - id: eic.h_wsb11_min
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B: smaller of lines 10 and 7"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.h_wsb7, eic.line5]}
  - id: eic.h_wsb11
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 11: this is your earned income credit"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard:
            op: test
            any:
              - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb9, {const: true}]}
              - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_below, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_wsb7
        - guard:
            op: test
            not:
              op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb9, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_below, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_wsb11_min

  - id: eic.h_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Earned income credit from the worksheet that applies"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_use_wsb, {const: true}]}, then: eic.h_wsb11}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_use_wsb, {const: false}]}, then: eic.line6}

  # Step 1 and Step 2
  - id: eic.h_s1_agi
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1, question 1: Form 1040 line 11b is less than the limit"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, lt: [f1040.line11b, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_7a_pos
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 1040 line 7a (if a loss, enter -0-)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: f1040.line7a, take: {const: 0}}

  - id: eic.h_inv
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 2, question 1: investment income (lines 2a, 2b, 3b and 7a)"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [f1040.line2a, f1040.line2b, f1040.line3b, eic.h_7a_pos]}

  - id: eic.h_inv_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 2, question 2: investment income is not more than $11,950"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, le: [eic.h_inv, {param: eic.investment_limit}]}
    note: "Above the limit, Step 2 question 3 asks about Form 4797. The tool treats the filer as not filing Form 4797, which gives STOP."

  - id: eic.h_s12_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Steps 1 and 2 passed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s1_agi, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.all_eic_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_inv_ok, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_s1_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1, question 2 answered No (check line 27c)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s1_agi, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.all_eic_ssn, {const: false}]}

  # Steps 3 and 4
  - id: eic.h_has_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3, question 1: at least one child who meets the conditions to be your qualifying child"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}

  - id: eic.h_married_sep
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Married taxpayer whose filing status is married filing separately or head of household"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "hoh"}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [household.married, {const: true}]}
    note: "A married head-of-household filer is identified through household.married, read as married at the end of 2025."

  - id: eic.h_c_stop_sep
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3, questions 3 to 5: STOP (same home for the last 6 months and not legally separated)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: false}]}

  - id: eic.h_c_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3 passed (filer with a qualifying child)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_c_stop_sep, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}

  - id: eic.h_c_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3, question 6 answered Yes (check line 27c)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_c_stop_sep, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_age_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of you (and your spouse) at least age 25 but under 65 at the end of 2025"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.one
      where:
        op: test
        all:
          - {op: test, eq: [person.eic_age25, {const: true}]}
          - {op: test, eq: [person.eic_under65, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_age_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 2: you, or your spouse if filing jointly, at least age 25 but under 65"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_age_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
    refuses: [eic.died_this_year]

  - id: eic.h_n_pre
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, questions 1 and 2 passed (filer without a qualifying child)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_age_ok, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_n_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 3 No or question 5 Yes (check line 27c)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_pre, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: false}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_n_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4 passed (filer without a qualifying child)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_pre, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_mfj, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [sa.dependent, {const: false}]}
    note: "Step 4 question 6 (can be claimed as a dependent) is read from sa.dependent. Its dual-status alien part is covered by the refusal on scope.nonresident."

  - id: eic.h_s34_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3 or Step 4 passed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_c_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_ok, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_s34_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3 or Step 4 STOP with instruction to check line 27c"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_c_27c, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_n_27c, {const: true}]}

  # Step 5 and worksheet stops
  - id: eic.h_s5_wsa_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5, question 3: earned income is less than the limit"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, lt: [eic.earned_income, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_s5_wsb_pos
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 4b is more than zero"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.wsb_4b, {const: 0}]}

  - id: eic.h_s5_wsb_lim
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B question 5: line 4b is less than the limit"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, lt: [eic.wsb_4b, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_s5_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Earned income test passed (Step 5 question 3, or Worksheet B lines 4b and 5)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_use_wsb, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s5_wsa_ok, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_use_wsb, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s5_wsb_pos, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s5_wsb_lim, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_s5_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 4b zero or less, or question 5 answered No (check line 27c)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_use_wsb, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          not:
            op: test
            all:
              - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s5_wsb_pos, {const: true}]}
              - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_s5_wsb_lim, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_ws_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet A line 2, or Worksheet B line 7, is zero (STOP; check line 27c)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_use_wsb, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_use_wsb, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_wsb7, {const: 0}]}
```
